The structure of La8Cu4Au4 (reduced formula La2CuAu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Au and Cu centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while La centers have 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.01 to 3.59 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Au and Cu coordination polyhedra linked by corner, edge, and face sharing, while Au–La and Cu–La polyhedra share corners and edges.
